hook: 押韻族 -ound：聲音與困局在場內來回撞。
script: profound 深到見底；confound 攪混讓人懵。expound 展開說明；impound 扣押封存。resound 回聲震場；astound 震驚全場。compound 複合加重；rebound 反彈。surround 包圍；abound 充斥。

members.speakLineEn: A profound limit is better admitted early.
members.speakLineZh: 深刻限制最好及早承認。

members.senseAnchor: be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly; mistake one thing for another
members.speakLineEn: Age may confound the treatment association.
members.speakLineZh: 年齡可能混淆處理關聯。

related.synonyms: confuse, throw, fox, befuddle, fuddle, bedevil

members.senseAnchor: add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing; state
members.speakLineEn: Expound the identification strategy in plain English.

related.synonyms: elaborate, lucubrate, expatiate, exposit, enlarge, expand

members.senseAnchor: take temporary possession of as a security, by legal authority; place or shut up in a pound
members.speakLineEn: Impound contested datasets until audit ends.
members.speakLineZh: 稽核結束前扣押爭議資料集。

members.senseAnchor: ring or echo with sound; emit a noise
members.speakLineEn: The critique will resound across methods blogs.
members.speakLineZh: 批評會在方法部落格回響。

members.speakLineEn: Null results can still astound optimistic fields.
members.speakLineZh: 虛無結果仍能震驚樂觀領域。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data can compound selection bias.
members.speakLineZh: 缺失資料會加重選擇偏差。

members.speakLineEn: Effects may rebound after the intervention ends.
members.speakLineZh: 介入結束後效應可能反彈。
用不確定區間包圍主張。

members.senseAnchor: to exist in very large numbers
members.speakLineEn: Cautionary tales abound after overclaimed RCTs.
members.speakLineZh: 過度宣稱隨機試驗後警世故事充斥。
無界研究者自由誘發淘篩。

members.speakLineEn: Ground theory in measurement, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 把理論落在測量上而非感覺。

pitfalls: confound 統計上＝混淆變項；日常也可「使困惑」
